name: OpenVibe.Homes
tagline: Homes to own, every site at once.
description: OpenVibe.Homes is the owning side of OpenVibe.Rent: one search opens homes for sale on Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, Homes.com, Trulia and Craigslist for a place, with government and bank homes (HUD, HomePath, auctions), land and commercial listings, the county's property records, local home prices from the FHFA index and a mortgage calculator. Listings stay on the sites that hold them.

pillars.title: Every for-sale site
pillars.text: One search opens Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, Homes.com, Trulia and Craigslist at your place, with your price and bedrooms.

pillars.title: Foreclosures, land, commercial
pillars.text: HUD homes, Fannie Mae HomePath and auctions; land and commercial listings for the same place.

pillars.title: Property records
pillars.text: The county records directory for every US state: deeds, assessments and tax records at their source.

pillars.title: Prices and payments
pillars.text: Local home price changes from the FHFA index and a mortgage calculator with tax, insurance and HOA.

faq.question: Does OpenVibe.Homes list homes itself?
faq.answer: No. One search opens Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, Homes.com, Trulia and Craigslist at your place, price and bedrooms. Listings stay on the sites that hold them.

faq.question: Can I find foreclosures and land?
faq.answer: Yes: HUD homes, Fannie Mae HomePath and auctions, plus land and commercial listings for the same place.

faq.question: Where are property records?
faq.answer: Homes links every US state's county records: deeds, assessments and tax records at their source.

faq.question: What do homes cost in my city?
faq.answer: City pages show the median home value with the FHFA price trend, and the mortgage calculator adds tax, insurance and HOA.

keywords: openvibe homes, homes for sale, foreclosures, land for sale, property records, mortgage calculator, real estate search
